progressSummary: Audited V3-08 requires repair; WIP baseline preserved when a safe delta existed.

openFindings.problem: The concrete emulator blocker is not repaired. The candidate's wrapper-timing changes (boot wait 420s->60s, settle 30s->10s, install 3->2 attempts bounded by timeout(120), single-attempt adb health check) are safe improvements but do not address the actual failure: the E2E script's waitFor('Demarrer', 900000) timed out because the app never showed the 'Demarrer' sign-in button within 900s of launch (cold start / demo sign-in / app crash / dump fragility / System UI overlay). The step has no hard timeout (workflow sets no timeout-minutes; android-emulator-runner@v2 runs the script via exec without a timeout wrapper; its only timeout is emulator-boot-timeout=600s for boot), so reducing wrapper overhead cannot change the E2E outcome — the E2E script's internal waitFor deadlines are fixed regardless of when the script starts.
openFindings.evidence: Public API: run 35650859523 step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' failed 20:36:13->20:57:12 UTC (20m59s=1259s) with all gates and the x86_64 release build passing; diagnostics artifact uploaded. Timing reconstruction: E2E envelope (launch ~120-150s + Demarrer 900s = ~1020-1050s) + wrapper overhead (~210-235s, dominated by a slow APK install) sums to ~1259s, matching the step duration — the failure is the Demarrer waitFor timeout, not boot/install. Action source (lib/main.js, lib/emulator-manager.js) confirms no script timeout and a boot wait that already polls sys.boot_completed before the script runs. Artifact download returns HTTP 401 and step logs HTTP 403 from this environment, so the blocker was reconstructed from the public API, workflow, action source and E2E script. The candidate delta contains no logcat/dumpsys/result.json analysis and no change to the app cold-start/sign-in path or to the E2E script's diagnostics.
openFindings.requiredFix: Keep the pristine navigation (router.push('/add') + setCurrentHouseholdId(id)) and keep the safe wrapper improvements, then repair the actual blocker: the app must reach the 'Demarrer' screen within the E2E script's fixed 900s window on the API 35 emulator. Investigate the app cold-start / demo sign-in / initial render path (Hermes init, splash screen, SQLite demo seeding, sign-in flow) and/or add mid-wait diagnostics to scripts/e2e-android.js (periodic logcat/dumpsys during the Demarrer wait, not only at timeout) so the next cycle can capture the exact failure point if it persists. Preserve V3-01..V3-07 invariants.
openFindings.verification: The next trusted finalizer dispatch (chorescore-v3-finalize.yml) must pass the Android API 35 install/launch/golden-path step with router.push('/add') in place; trusted verification exit 0; no regression in V3-01..V3-07 gates.
